diagnostic_scope.task_means: Entry-weighted means over all new batches; maximum is maximum observed entry value
diagnostic_scope.task_quantiles: Means of recorded batch medians/p90/p99, not pooled quantiles
diagnostic_scope.first_batch: One first natural batch per epoch, 50 batches per seed; within-seed means weight recorded batches equally

stage_advancement.reason: Both five-seed means of selected validation fixed-EMA Macro AUC NDP-A minus CLEAN are non-positive; Stage2 design section10 condition1 is met. CIs and seed direction counts are descriptive, not extra vetoes.
